rollback: Exact TEST and LIVE pre-release matcher definitions are retained privately; guarded rollback checks the installed candidate digest before restoring.
limits: These counts describe latest retained source observations, not Commusoft's complete current universe.
A source status does not verify job completion, payment, staff assignment or progress on the ground.
Filtering the review list does not itself confirm any of the 282 unmatched non-complete job identities; an authorised reviewer must inspect and link them through the existing saved batch path.
Ambiguous latest source versions are excluded from this filter and remain accessible through exact-ID review; they are not counted as successful matches.

Signed-in TEST synthetic and LIVE Drummonds operator review passed for the saved-status filter. The LIVE first page showed only on-hold statuses; it is not evidence of complete real job matching or full provider freshness.

The ordinary stable TEST login initially used an older cached asset after alias assignment; a later signed-in TEST operator session showed the new review control. The original cache condition was not independently root-caused.
